gaps.lead: Only after reading the letter twice did it make sense.
gaps.sentence: The letter ___ sense until it had been read twice.
gaps.explanation: It made sense only after two readings = it didn't make sense until it had been read twice.

gaps.lead: It's possible that she forgot about the meeting.
gaps.explanation: may/might have + participle = possibility in the past.

gaps.lead: Her French improved because she lived in Lyon.
gaps.sentence: Her French improved as ___ in Lyon.
gaps.explanation: as a result of + noun/-ing: as a result of living.

gaps.lead: He was in the habit of jogging every morning.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be in the habit of: was used to jogging.

gaps.lead: People say the castle is haunted.
gaps.explanation: People say → It is said… / The castle is said to be…

gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.
